## Climate distances

```{r climate-data}
prism_data <- read.csv(
  file.path(CA_CURTO_ROOT, "mg", "PRISM_ppt_tmin_tmean_tmax_30yr_normal_800m_monthly_normals.csv"),
  header = TRUE
) |>
  mutate(Name = as.factor(Name)) |>
  filter(!is.na(Longitude))

LOMA_prism <- read.csv(
  file.path(CA_CURTO_ROOT, "RTs", "LOMA_PRISM_ppt_tmin_tmean_tmax_30yr_normal_800m_monthly_normals.csv"),
  header = TRUE
)
prism_data <- bind_rows(prism_data, LOMA_prism)

# Compute 19 bioclimatic variables per reserve using dismo::biovars()6
bioclim_vars <- map_dfr(unique(prism_data$Name), function(nm) {
  d <- prism_data |> filter(Name == nm, Date != "Annual")
  bv <- biovars(d$ppt..mm., d$tmin..degrees.C., d$tmax..degrees.C.)
  tibble(reserve_litter = nm, as.data.frame(bv))
}) |>
  column_to_rownames("reserve_litter")

# PCA of climate; distances to LOMA in PCA space
pca_clim  <- prcomp(bioclim_vars |> distinct(.keep_all = TRUE), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
clim_dist <- as.matrix(dist(pca_clim$x))

exclude_reserves <- c("COP-G", "McLL-DV", "BOMR-G", "SNARL-G")

pca_clim_df2 <- pca_clim$x |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("reserve") |>
  left_join(bioclim_vars |> rownames_to_column("reserve"), by = "reserve") |>
  filter(!reserve %in% exclude_reserves) |>
  separate(col = "reserve", into = c("reserve", "litter"), remove = FALSE, fill = "warn") |>
  filter(reserve %in% c(others, "LOMA")) |>
  dplyr::select(-litter) |>
  mutate(
    PC1_LOMA_dist  = abs(PC1[reserve == "LOMA"] - PC1),
    PC2_LOMA_dist  = abs(PC2[reserve == "LOMA"] - PC2),
    MAT_LOMA_dist  = abs(bio1[reserve  == "LOMA"] - bio1),
    MTCQ_LOMA_dist = abs(bio11[reserve == "LOMA"] - bio11),
    MAP_LOMA_dist  = abs(bio12[reserve == "LOMA"] - bio12),
    PC_LOMA_dist   = sqrt((PC1 - PC1[reserve == "LOMA"])^2 +
                          (PC2 - PC2[reserve == "LOMA"])^2),
    # Scaled Euclidean MAT + MAP distance
    clim_LOMA_dist = sqrt(
      ((bio1  - bio1[reserve  == "LOMA"]) / sd(bio1))^2 +
      ((bio12 - bio12[reserve == "LOMA"]) / sd(bio12))^2
    )
  ) |>
  filter(reserve != "LOMA")

# Full Euclidean climate distance to LOMA
clim_dist_toLOMA <- clim_dist |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("reserve") |>
  filter(!reserve %in% exclude_reserves) |>
  separate(col = "reserve", into = c("reserve", "litter"), remove = FALSE, fill = "warn") |>
  filter(reserve %in% c(others, "LOMA")) |>
  dplyr::select(-litter) |>
  column_to_rownames("reserve") |>
  t() |> as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("reserve") |>
  filter(!reserve %in% exclude_reserves) |>
  separate(col = "reserve", into = c("reserve", "litter"), remove = FALSE, fill = "warn") |>
  filter(reserve %in% c(others, "LOMA")) |>
  dplyr::select(-litter) |>
  filter(reserve != "LOMA") |>
  dplyr::select(reserve, LOMA)

pca_clim_df2 <- pca_clim_df2 |>
  left_join(clim_dist_toLOMA, by = "reserve") |>
  rename(clim_dist_to_LOMA = LOMA) |>
  mutate(pair = paste(reserve, "vs", "LOMA"))

detach("package:dismo",  unload = TRUE)
detach("package:raster", unload = TRUE)
detach("package:sp",     unload = TRUE)
```

```{r site-bioclim-table}
# 9-site summary: reserve_code, lat/lon, and 19 bioclim variables.
# Lat/lon and bioclim values are averaged across the two litter types (G, DV)
# for each reserve. LOMA has a single entry and is included as-is.
experiment_reserves <- c(others, "LOMA")

coords <- prism_data |>
  select(Name, Latitude, Longitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  mutate(reserve_code = str_remove(as.character(Name), "-(G|DV)$")) |>
  filter(reserve_code %in% experiment_reserves) |>
  group_by(reserve_code) |>
  summarise(Latitude  = round(mean(Latitude),  4),
            Longitude = round(mean(Longitude), 4),
            .groups   = "drop")

bioclim_table <- bioclim_vars |>
  rownames_to_column("Name") |>
  mutate(reserve_code = str_remove(Name, "-(G|DV)$")) |>
  filter(reserve_code %in% experiment_reserves) |>
  group_by(reserve_code) |>
  summarise(across(starts_with("bio"), \(x) round(mean(x), 2)), .groups = "drop")

bioclim_names <- c(
  bio1  = "Annual Mean Temperature (°C)",
  bio2  = "Mean Diurnal Range (°C)",
  bio3  = "Isothermality",
  bio4  = "Temperature Seasonality",
  bio5  = "Max Temperature Warmest Month (°C)",
  bio6  = "Min Temperature Coldest Month (°C)",
  bio7  = "Temperature Annual Range (°C)",
  bio8  = "Mean Temperature Wettest Quarter (°C)",
  bio9  = "Mean Temperature Driest Quarter (°C)",
  bio10 = "Mean Temperature Warmest Quarter (°C)",
  bio11 = "Mean Temperature Coldest Quarter (°C)",
  bio12 = "Annual Precipitation (mm)",
  bio13 = "Precipitation Wettest Month (mm)",
  bio14 = "Precipitation Driest Month (mm)",
  bio15 = "Precipitation Seasonality (CV)",
  bio16 = "Precipitation Wettest Quarter (mm)",
  bio17 = "Precipitation Driest Quarter (mm)",
  bio18 = "Precipitation Warmest Quarter (mm)",
  bio19 = "Precipitation Coldest Quarter (mm)"
)

site_summary <- coords |>
  left_join(bioclim_table, by = "reserve_code") |>
  arrange(reserve_code) |>
  rename_with(~ bioclim_names[.x], .cols = starts_with("bio"))

print(site_summary)

write_xlsx(
  list("site_summary" = site_summary),
  path = file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "tables", "site_bioclim_summary.xlsx")
)
```

## Centroid-based community distances

```{r centroid-pipeline}
group_cols <- c("reserve_code", "s_code", "i_code", "Bag_type")

res_centroid <- centroid_dm_rarefy(
  comm       = as.data.frame(t(rtB4rar@otu_table)),
  meta       = metadata,
  group_cols = group_cols,
  depth      = RAREFY_DEPTH_SUBCL2,
  iterations = N_ITER,
  seed       = SEED
)

comp_vs_loma <- extract_loma_pairs(res_centroid, group_cols = group_cols)
```

```{r pair-block-dists}
ids_all <- meta_filt$original_label
D_full  <- as.matrix(mg_subclds_distmat)[ids_all, ids_all, drop = FALSE]

pairs_vec <- meta_filt$pair |> unique() |> sort()
pairs_vec <- pairs_vec[grepl(" vs LOMA$", pairs_vec) & !grepl("^LOMA vs LOMA$", pairs_vec)]
loma_home_idx <- which(meta_filt$reserve_code == "LOMA" &
                       meta_filt$s_code        == "LOMA" &
                       meta_filt$i_code        == "LOMA")

pair_dists <- map_dfr(pairs_vec, function(p) {
  rows     <- union(which(meta_filt$pair == p), loma_home_idx)
  Dp       <- D_full[rows, rows, drop = FALSE]
  grp      <- meta_filt$reserve_code[rows]
  away_res <- str_split(p, " ", simplify = TRUE)[, 1]
  keep     <- grp %in% c("LOMA", away_res)
  Dp       <- Dp[keep, keep, drop = FALSE]
  grp      <- factor(grp[keep], levels = c("LOMA", away_res))
  if (nlevels(grp) != 2 || nrow(Dp) < 2) return(tibble())
  res <- avg_block_dists_plus(Dp, grp)
  tibble(
    pair              = p,
    away_res          = away_res,
    n_LOMA            = res$n["LOMA"],
    n_away            = res$n[away_res],
    mean_between      = res$between["LOMA", away_res],
    mean_within_LOMA  = res$between["LOMA", "LOMA"],
    mean_within_away  = res$between[away_res, away_res],
    pairs_between     = res$pairs_between["LOMA", away_res],
    pairs_within_LOMA = res$pairs_within["LOMA"],
    pairs_within_away = res$pairs_within[away_res]
  )
}) |>
  left_join(pca_clim_df2 |> select(reserve, PC1, PC2, PC1_LOMA_dist, PC2_LOMA_dist,
                                    clim_dist_to_LOMA),
            by = c("away_res" = "reserve")) |>
  left_join(clim_dist_toLOMA |> rename(euc_clim = LOMA),
            by = c("away_res" = "reserve"))
```

## Community vs climate distance correlation

```{r comm-clim-corr}
df_corr <- pair_dists |>
  distinct(away_res, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  drop_na(mean_between, euc_clim)

ct_pear  <- cor.test(df_corr$euc_clim, df_corr$mean_between, method = "pearson")
ct_spear <- cor.test(df_corr$euc_clim, df_corr$mean_between, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
m_lm     <- lm(mean_between ~ euc_clim, data = df_corr)
R2       <- summary(m_lm)$r.squared

# ⚠️ n = 8 pairs — interpret with caution; small-sample correlation is unstable.
ann_lab <- sprintf(
  "Pearson r = %.2f (p = %.3f)\nSpearman ρ = %.2f (p = %.3f)\nR² = %.2f\nn = %d",
  ct_pear$estimate,  ct_pear$p.value,
  ct_spear$estimate, ct_spear$p.value,
  R2, nrow(df_corr)
)

ggplot(df_corr, aes(x = euc_clim, y = mean_between, label = away_res)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, min.segment.length = 0) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
           label = ann_lab, size = 3.5) +
  labs(title = "Community dissimilarity vs. climate distance to LOMA",
       x     = "Climate distance to LOMA (Euclidean in bioclim PCA space)",
       y     = "Community dissimilarity to LOMA (Bray–Curtis, centroids)") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "plots", "comm_clim_dist_corr.png"),
       width = 132, height = 120, units = "mm", dpi = 300)
```

```{r check-paths}
}
```

## Convergence paths — Curtobacterium subclades (Euclidean, top 4 subclades)

```{r paths-euc}
rt_TopSubclades <- subset_taxa(rt_subclades, subclade %in% c("IC", "IIG", "IIIA", "IVB"))
curto_Top4_otutab <- as.data.frame(t(rt_TopSubclades@otu_table))
cat("Min library size (top 4 subclades):", min(sample_sums(rt_TopSubclades)), "\n")

avg_euc <- calc_rarefaction_euclidean(
  otu_table      = curto_Top4_otutab,
  n_iterations   = N_ITER,
  sequence_depth = RAREFY_DEPTH_TOP4,
  set_seed       = SEED
)

paths_df_euc <- compute_all_paths(as.matrix(avg_euc), meta_ext, zero_R_within = FALSE)
```

## Convergence paths — Bacterial genera (Bray–Curtis and Euclidean)

```{r paths-genus}
paths_df_genus <- compute_all_paths(as.matrix(mg_genus_distmat), meta_ext, zero_R_within = FALSE)

top400_genera  <- names(sort(taxa_sums(rt_g), decreasing = TRUE)[1:400])
rt_g_top400    <- prune_taxa(top400_genera, rt_g)
cat("Min library size (top 400 genera):", min(sample_sums(rt_g_top400)), "\n")

genus_avg_euc  <- calc_rarefaction_euclidean(
  otu_table      = as.data.frame(t(rt_g_top400@otu_table)),
  n_iterations   = N_ITER,
  sequence_depth = min(sample_sums(rt_g_top400)),
  set_seed       = SEED
)
paths_df_genus_euc <- compute_all_paths(as.matrix(genus_avg_euc), meta_ext, zero_R_within = FALSE)
```

## Convergence plots

```{r convergence-plot-by-site}
convergence_by_pair_subclades <- paths_df_euc |>
  mutate(path = factor(path, levels = names(path_colors))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = path)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_col(aes(y = F_s1_R0, fill = path), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ pair, ncol = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = path_colors,
                    labels = c("Climate (Loma)", "Litter (Loma)", "Climate & litter (Loma)",
                                "Climate (away)", "Litter (away)")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Convergence (S)") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 0.4, size = 0, linetype = 1))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position        = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(1, 1),
        legend.justification   = c(1, 1),
        legend.background      = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.5), colour = alpha("grey80", 0.5)),
        legend.key.size        = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        legend.text            = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title           = element_blank())

print(convergence_by_pair_subclades)

ggsave(file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "plots", "Convergence_R_plot_by_site.png"),
       width = 216, height = 120, units = "mm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r convergence-with-steps}
# LOMA paths — stepwise convergence components
p_dat_LOMA <- paths_df_euc |>
  filter(!path %in% c("away_clim_eff", "away_litt_eff")) |>
  mutate(path = factor(str_remove(path, "LOMA_"),
                       levels = c("clim_eff", "litt_eff", "int_eff"),
                       labels = c("Climate", "Litter", "Interaction"))) |>
  select(pair, path, delta1_R0, delta2_R0, total_delta_R0, eta1_R0, eta2_R0) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(delta1_R0, delta2_R0, total_delta_R0, eta1_R0, eta2_R0),
               names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(metric = factor(metric,
                         levels = c("delta1_R0", "delta2_R0", "total_delta_R0", "eta1_R0", "eta2_R0"),
                         labels = c("S0→S1", "S1→R", "S0→R", "Eff.S0→S1", "Eff.S1→R")))

ggplot(p_dat_LOMA, aes(x = path, y = value, fill = metric)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65) +
  facet_nested_wrap(~ pair + path, scales = "free_x", ncol = 12) +
  labs(y = "Convergence toward R0 (Δ Euclidean)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#8888ff", "#88cc88", "#222222", "#009ACD", "#2E8B57")) +
  theme_minimal() +
```

## Randomization tests on F_s1_R0

```{r convergence-randomization-tests}
set.seed(7341)

# Q1: Exact sign permutation test — is mean F_s1_R0 different from 0 per path?
# Under H0, signs of the 8 pair values are arbitrary; all 2^8 = 256 combinations
# are enumerated exactly. p-value = fraction of permuted |means| >= |observed mean|.
sign_perm_test <- function(x) {
  obs_mean   <- mean(x)
  signs      <- expand.grid(rep(list(c(-1, 1)), length(x)))
  perm_means <- apply(signs, 1, function(s) mean(x * s))
  p_value    <- mean(abs(perm_means) >= abs(obs_mean))
  tibble(obs_mean = obs_mean, p_value = p_value, n_perms = nrow(signs))
}

q1_results <- conv_both |>
  group_by(community, path) |>
  summarise(sign_perm_test(F_s1_R0), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(community) |>
  mutate(p_adj_fdr = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4))) |>
  arrange(community, p_adj_fdr)

cat("--- Q1: Mean F_s1_R0 different from 0? ---\n")
print(q1_results)

# Q2: Within-pair permutation F-test — omnibus path differences
# Two-way ANOVA (F_s1_R0 ~ path + pair) partitions out pair-level variance.
# Path labels are permuted within each pair independently, preserving the
# repeated-measures structure. p-value = fraction of permuted F >= observed F.
perm_F_within_pairs <- function(df, n_perm = 9999) {
  obs_F <- summary(aov(F_s1_R0 ~ path + pair, data = df))[[1]]["path", "F value"]

  perm_Fs <- replicate(n_perm, {
    df_perm <- df |>
      group_by(pair) |>
      mutate(path = sample(path)) |>
      ungroup()
    summary(aov(F_s1_R0 ~ path + pair, data = df_perm))[[1]]["path", "F value"]
  })

  p_value <- mean(c(perm_Fs, obs_F) >= obs_F)
  tibble(obs_F = round(obs_F, 4), p_value = p_value, n_perm = n_perm + 1)
}

q2_results <- conv_both |>
  group_by(community) |>
  group_modify(~ perm_F_within_pairs(.x)) |>
  ungroup()

cat("\n--- Q2: Omnibus path differences (within-pair permutation F-test) ---\n")
print(q2_results)
```

```{r convergence-bootstrap-test}
# Bootstrap mean test — alternative to sign permutation that does not assume
# symmetry of the null distribution around 0.
# Logic: shift data to H0 (subtract observed mean), resample with replacement,
# ask how often the bootstrap |mean| >= |observed mean|. No symmetry assumption.
set.seed(7341)

bootstrap_mean_test <- function(x, n_boot = 9999) {
  obs_mean   <- mean(x)
  x_shifted  <- x - obs_mean          # centre at 0 to impose H0
  boot_means <- replicate(n_boot, mean(sample(x_shifted, replace = TRUE)))
  p_value    <- mean(abs(c(boot_means, obs_mean)) >= abs(obs_mean))
  tibble(obs_mean = obs_mean, p_value = p_value, n_boot = n_boot + 1)
}

q1_bootstrap <- conv_both |>
  group_by(community, path) |>
  summarise(bootstrap_mean_test(F_s1_R0), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(community) |>
  mutate(p_adj_fdr = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4))) |>
  arrange(community, p_adj_fdr)

cat("--- Bootstrap test: Mean F_s1_R0 different from 0? ---\n")
print(q1_bootstrap)

# Side-by-side comparison with sign permutation results
cat("\n--- Comparison: sign permutation vs bootstrap (FDR-adjusted p-values) ---\n")
q1_results |>
  select(community, path, sign_p_adj = p_adj_fdr) |>
  left_join(q1_bootstrap |> select(community, path, boot_p_adj = p_adj_fdr),
            by = c("community", "path")) |>
  arrange(community, sign_p_adj) |>
  print()
```

```{r subclades-ra-trajectories}
  add_pair_label() |>
```

```{r curto-ra-genus}
genus_RA_ext_df     <- expand_loma_rows(genus_df_bp, others)

genus_RA_ext_df_avg <- genus_RA_ext_df |>
  group_by(pair, i_r_l) |>
  summarise(meanRA = mean(Abundance),
            sdRA   = sd(Abundance),
            seRA   = sd(Abundance) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  inner_join(plot_paths_RA, by = "i_r_l") |>
  filter(pair != "LOMA vs LOMA") |>
  mutate(path = factor(path, levels = c("Climate", "Litter", "Interaction")))

genus_RA_ext_df_avg |>
  filter(source == "LOMA") |>
  ggplot(aes(step, meanRA, group = interaction(pair, path))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) + geom_point(size = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = meanRA - seRA, ymax = meanRA + seRA), width = 0.06, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:2, labels = c("LOMA", "Intermediate", "Away")) +
  labs(x = "Step", y = "Mean Curtobacterium Rel. Abundance") +
  facet_grid(path ~ pair) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 8))

ggsave(file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "plots", "CURTO_RA_by_pair_path.png"),
       width = 200, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## Top 5 genera relative abundance trajectories

```{r top5-genera-ra}
top5_genera <- c("Pseudomonas_E", "Sphingomonas", "Telluria",
                 "Curtobacterium", "Mucilaginibacter")

top5_df_bp <- transform_sample_counts(rt_g, function(x) x / sum(x)) |>
  psmelt() |>
  filter(Bag_type == "Closed", i_code != "none", OTU %in% top5_genera) |>
  add_pair_label() |>
  add_irl_label()

top5_RA_ext_df <- expand_loma_rows(top5_df_bp, others)

top5_RA_ext_df_avg <- top5_RA_ext_df |>
  group_by(OTU, pair, i_r_l) |>
  summarise(meanRA = mean(Abundance),
            sdRA   = sd(Abundance),
            seRA   = sd(Abundance) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  inner_join(plot_paths_RA, by = "i_r_l") |>
  filter(pair != "LOMA vs LOMA") |>
  mutate(path = factor(path, levels = c("Climate", "Litter", "Interaction")),
         OTU  = factor(OTU, levels = top5_genera))

top5_RA_ext_df_avg |>
  filter(source == "LOMA") |>
  ggplot(aes(step, meanRA, color = OTU, group = interaction(OTU, pair))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = meanRA - seRA, ymax = meanRA + seRA),
                width = 0.06, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:2, labels = c("S0", "S1", "R")) +
  labs(x = "Step", y = "Mean Rel. Abundance", color = "Genus") +
  facet_grid(path ~ pair) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 8))

ggsave(file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "plots", "Top5genera_RA_by_pair_path.png"),
       width = 280, height = 180, units = "mm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## Taxa var plot for the top 10 most abundant genera

```{r taxa-barplot-top10-genera}


# --- 1. Compute per-sample relative abundances for ALL genera ---
all_genera_df_bp <- transform_sample_counts(rt_g, function(x) x / sum(x)) |>
  psmelt() |>
  filter(Bag_type == "Closed", i_code != "none") |>
  add_pair_label() |>
  add_irl_label()

all_genera_RA_ext_df <- expand_loma_rows(all_genera_df_bp, others)

# --- 2. Identify top 10 genera by overall mean RA ---
top10_genera <- all_genera_RA_ext_df |>
  group_by(OTU) |>
  summarise(meanRA = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop") |>
  slice_max(meanRA, n = 10) |>
  arrange(desc(meanRA)) |>
  pull(OTU)

cat("Top 10 genera:\n")
print(top10_genera)

# --- 3. Per-sample: sum non-top10 into "Others" ---
per_sample_grouped <- all_genera_RA_ext_df |>
  mutate(genus_group = if_else(OTU %in% top10_genera, OTU, "Others")) |>
  group_by(Sample, genus_group, pair, i_r_l) |>
  summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")


taxa_bar_avg <- per_sample_grouped |>
  group_by(genus_group, pair, i_r_l) |>
  summarise(meanRA = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop") |>
  inner_join(plot_paths_RA, by = "i_r_l", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  filter(pair != "LOMA vs LOMA", source == "LOMA") |>
  mutate(
    path        = factor(path, levels = c("Climate", "Litter", "Interaction")),
    genus_group = factor(genus_group, levels = c(top10_genera, "Others")),
    step_label  = factor(step, levels = 0:2, labels = c("S0", "S1", "R"))
  )

genus_colors <- c(
  setNames(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(10, "Paired"), top10_genera),
  Others = "gray70"
)


taxa_bar_avg |>
  mutate(step_label = factor(step, levels = 0:2, labels = c("H0", "I", "A0"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = step_label, y = meanRA, fill = genus_group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = genus_colors, name = "Genus") +
  facet_grid(path ~ pair) +
  labs(x = "Step", y = "Mean Relative Abundance") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text            = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "right",
    strip.text      = element_text(size = 7)
  )


ggsave(file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "plots", "Top10genera_taxabarplot_by_pair_path.png"),
       width = 280, height = 180, units = "mm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")

```
